name: Direct Line
source:
You bought an old-fashioned phone from a yard sale, thinking it would look cool in your room...until it rings in the middle of the night. You answer, only to hear a mysterious voice that claims you called them. Wait... then why did the phone ring?

[From [url=https://inkycosmos.itch.io/direct-line]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你从旧货旧货出售中买了一部老式电话，以为它放在你的房间里会很酷……直到它在半夜响起。你接听，却听到一个神秘的声音，声称是你给他们打电话的。等等……那电话怎么突然响了？

[来自[url=https://inkycosmos.itch.io/direct-line]itch.io[/url]]
